pattern: Indirect Speech + ~는/은/ㄴ/던 말이다 (I Mean / What I'm Saying Is)
meaningEn: Clarifying or emphasizing what one just said or meant ('I mean... / What I'm saying is...').
meaningId: Menjelaskan atau menekankan apa yang baru saja dikatakan atau dimaksudkan ('maksud saya... / yang saya katakan adalah...').

notesEn.formation: Verb: ~다는 말이다 / Adj: ~다는 말이다 / Noun: ~(이)라는 말이다 / Question: ~(느)냐는 말이다 / Imperative: ~(으)라는 말이다.
notesEn.usage: Used to clarify one's intention, double-check another person's statement, or emphasize a point.
notesEn.nuance: Can convey mild frustration or insistence depending on tone.

notesId.formation: Kata Kerja: ~다는 말이다 / Kata Sifat: ~다는 말이다 / Kata Benda: ~(이)라는 말이다 / Pertanyaan: ~(느)냐는 말이다 / Perintah: ~(으)라는 말이다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan untuk memperjelas maksud sendiri, memastikan kembali pernyataan orang lain, atau menekankan suatu poin.
notesId.nuance: Dapat menyampaikan sedikit rasa frustrasi atau penegasan tergantung pada nada bicara.

examples.meaningEn: I mean we should depart right now.
examples.meaningId: Maksud saya, kita harus berangkat sekarang juga.

examples.hangul: 그게 무슨 말이에요? 안 가겠다는 말이에요?
examples.romaja: geu-ge mu-seun mal-i-e-yo? an ga-ges-da-neun mal-i-e-yo?
examples.meaningEn: What do you mean by that? Are you saying you won't go?
examples.meaningId: Apa maksudnya? Maksudmu kamu tidak akan pergi?

examples.meaningEn: In other words, what I'm saying is we don't have time.
examples.meaningId: Dengan kata lain, maksud saya adalah kita tidak punya waktu.

quiz.question: Which construction is used to clarify one's previous statement by saying 'What I mean is...'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~다는 말이다 embeds an indirect quote to clarify 'what I am saying is...'.
quiz.explanationId: ~다는 말이다 menyisipkan kutipan tidak langsung untuk memperjelas 'maksud saya adalah...'.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: In other words, what I'm saying is we don't have time. -> 다시 말해서, 시간이 없다는 ___입니다.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I mean we should depart right now.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Maksud saya, kita harus berangkat sekarang juga.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use now right away (지금 바로) + let's depart quote (출발하자는) + I mean (말이에요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan sekarang juga (지금 바로) + kutipan mari berangkat (출발하자는) + maksud saya (말이에요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)나 마나 (No Need to Even Check / It Goes Without Saying)
meaningEn: Expressing that the result will be obvious regardless of whether an action is performed ('whether you do it or not').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa hasilnya sudah jelas tertebak terlepas dari apakah tindakan tersebut dilakukan atau tidak ('dilakukan atau tidak, hasilnya tetap sama').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~나 마나 / Consonant stem -> ~으나 마나.
notesEn.usage: Used when an outcome is so certain that actually checking or attempting the action is pointless.
notesEn.nuance: Slightly more opinionated than ~아/어 봤자; implies 'don't even bother checking'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~나 마나 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~으나 마나.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika suatu hasil sangat pasti sehingga benar-benar memeriksa atau mencoba tindakan tersebut menjadi tidak berguna.
notesId.nuance: Sedikit lebih beropini dibandingkan ~아/어 봤자; menyiratkan 'tidak perlu repot-repot memeriksa'.

examples.meaningEn: Whether you look or not, the outcome is obvious.
examples.meaningId: Dilihat atau tidak, hasilnya sudah pasti jelas.

examples.hangul: 물어보나 마나 안 된다고 할 거예요.
examples.romaja: mu-reo-bo-na ma-na an doen-da-go hal geo-ye-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Whether you ask or not, they will say no.
examples.meaningId: Ditanya atau tidak, mereka pasti akan bilang tidak boleh.

examples.meaningEn: Whether you taste it or not, it's guaranteed to be delicious.
examples.meaningId: Dicicipi atau tidak, pasti rasanya enak.

quiz.question: What does '물어보나 마나' indicate?
options: Asking is useless because the outcome is obvious
I will ask after I finish
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)나 마나 indicates that doing the action won't change or reveal anything unexpected.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)나 마나 menunjukkan bahwa melakukan tindakan tersebut tidak akan mengubah atau mengungkapkan hal yang tidak terduga.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Whether you ask or not, they will say no. -> 물어보___ 안 된다고 할 거예요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert connector indicating obvious outcome without checking.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata penghubung yang menunjukkan hasil jelas tanpa perlu diperiksa.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Whether you ask or not, they will say no.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Ditanya atau tidak, mereka pasti akan bilang tidak boleh.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 물어보나 마나 안 된다고 할 거예요
constructionQuiz.answerReading: mu-reo-bo-na ma-na an doen-da-go hal geo-ye-yo
acceptableVariants: 물어보나 마나 안 된다고 할 겁니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use ask (물어보) + whether or not (나 마나) + won't work quote (안 된다고) + will say (할 거예요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan bertanya (물어보) + dilakukan atau tidak (나 마나) + kutipan tidak bisa (안 된다고) + akan berkata (할 거예요).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 (No Way That... / Impossible)
meaningEn: Expressing strong disbelief or conviction that something cannot be true ('there is no way / impossible').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan ketidakpercayaan yang kuat atau keyakinan bahwa sesuatu tidak mungkin benar ('tidak mungkin / tidak ada alasan bahwa').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 리가 없다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 리가 없다. Past: ~았/었을 리가 없다.
notesEn.usage: Used when rejecting a possibility based on logical reasoning or past evidence.
notesEn.nuance: 리 refers to 'reason/logic'. Directly means 'there exists no logic for X'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 리가 없다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 리가 없다. Lampau: ~았/었을 리가 없다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan saat menolak suatu kemungkinan berdasarkan penalaran logis atau bukti masa lalu.
notesId.nuance: 리 mengacu pada 'alasan/logika'. Secara harfiah berarti 'tidak ada logika untuk X'.

examples.hangul: 그 사람이 거짓말을 했을 리가 없어요.
examples.romaja: geu sa-ram-i geo-jit-mal-eul haes-seul ri-ga eobs-eo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: There is no way that person lied.
There is no way they have already arrived.
There is no way that rumor is true.

quiz.question: Which sentence means 'There is no way that person lied'?
options: 그 사람이 거짓말을 했을 리가 없어요
그 사람이 거짓말을 했을 수밖에 없어요
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 expresses strong doubt/impossibility ('no way').
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 mengekspresikan keraguan kuat/ketidakmungkinan ('tidak mungkin').

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: There is no way that person lied. -> 그 사람이 거짓말을 했을 ___ 없어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert bound noun 'reason/logic' with subject particle.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat 'alasan/logika' dengan partikel subjek.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'There is no way that person lied.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Tidak mungkin orang itu berbohong.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 그 사람이 거짓말을 했을 리가 없어요
constructionQuiz.answerReading: geu sa-ram-i geo-jit-mal-eul haes-seul ri-ga eobs-eo-yo
acceptableVariants: 그 사람이 거짓말을 했을 리가 없습니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use that person (그 사람이) + lied past modifier (거짓말을 했을) + no way (리가 없어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan orang itu (그 사람이) + penjelas berbohong lampau (거짓말을 했을) + tidak mungkin (리가 없어요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~기 십상이다 (Easy to / Likely to - Negative Outcome)
meaningEn: Expressing a high risk or tendency of a negative outcome occurring ('apt to / easy to').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan risiko tinggi atau kecenderungan terjadinya hasil negatif ('mudah sekali / rawan untuk').

notesEn.usage: Warns about a common mistake or negative tendency if careful attention is not paid.
notesEn.nuance: Synonymous with ~기 쉽다, but almost exclusively used for negative/unfavorable pitfalls.

notesId.usage: Memeperingatkan tentang kesalahan umum atau kecenderungan negatif jika tidak berhati-hati.
notesId.nuance: Sinonim dengan ~기 쉽다, tetapi hampir secara eksklusif digunakan untuk jebakan/hasil yang negatif.

examples.meaningEn: If you rush, it is easy to make a mistake.
examples.meaningId: Jika terburu-buru, sangat rawan membuat kesalahan.

examples.meaningEn: If you let your guard down, an accident is apt to happen.
examples.meaningId: Jika lengah, sangat mudah terjadi kecelakaan.

examples.meaningEn: Beginners are apt to lose their way.

quiz.question: What nuance does '~기 십상이다' carry?
options: High likelihood of a negative pitfall/mistake
quiz.explanationEn: ~기 십상이다 specifically highlights vulnerability to a negative outcome.
quiz.explanationId: ~기 십상이다 secara khusus menyoroti kerawanan terhadap hasil negatif.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: If you rush, it is easy to make a mistake. -> 서두르다 보면 실수하___.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert pattern meaning 'apt to make a negative mistake'.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan pola yang berarti 'rawan membuat kesalahan negatif'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'If you rush, it is easy to make a mistake.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Jika terburu-buru, sangat rawan membuat kesalahan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use rush while doing (서두르다 보면) + make mistake (실수하) + apt to (기 십상이에요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan terburu-buru saat melakukan (서두르다 보면) + buat kesalahan (실수하) + rawan (기 십상이에요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~는 한 (As Long As / On Condition That)
meaningEn: Setting a condition or boundary ('as long as / provided that').

notesEn.usage: Indicates that the state or action in the second clause remains valid as long as the condition in the first clause continues.
notesEn.nuance: Creates a logical boundary or threshold for the main action.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~는 한. Lampau/Selesai: ~(으)ㄴ 한.
notesId.usage: Menunjukkan bahwa kondisi atau tindakan pada klausa kedua tetap berlaku selama kondisi pada klausa pertama terus berlanjut.
notesId.nuance: Menciptakan batasan logis atau ambang batas untuk tindakan utama.

examples.hangul: 내가 살아 있는 한 너를 지켜줄게.
examples.romaja: nae-ga sal-a it-neun han neo-reul ji-kyeo-jul-ge.
examples.meaningEn: As long as I am alive, I will protect you.
examples.meaningId: Selama aku masih hidup, aku akan melindungimu.

examples.hangul: 최선을 다하는 한 후회는 없을 거예요.
examples.romaja: choe-seon-eul da-ha-neun han hu-hoe-neun eobs-eul geo-ye-yo.
examples.meaningEn: As long as you do your best, there will be no regrets.
examples.meaningId: Selama kamu melakukan yang terbaik, tidak akan ada penyesalan.

examples.hangul: 특별한 이유가 없는 한 참여해야 합니다.
examples.romaja: teuk-byeol-han i-yu-ga eobs-neun han cham-yeo-hae-ya ham-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: Unless there is a special reason, you must participate.
examples.meaningId: Selama tidak ada alasan khusus, Anda harus berpartisipasi.

quiz.question: Which connector means 'as long as / provided that'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~는 한 establishes a temporal or conditional limit ('as long as').
quiz.explanationId: ~는 한 menetapkan batasan temporal atau bersyarat ('selama').

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'As long as I am alive, I will protect you.'

constructionQuiz.answer: 내가 살아 있는 한 너를 지켜줄게

제가 살아 있는 한 당신을 지켜드릴게요
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use I (내가) + alive modifier (살아 있는) + as long as (한) + protect you (너를 지켜줄게).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan aku (내가) + penjelas hidup (살아 있는) + selama (한) + melindungimu (너를 지켜줄게).
